HELP_MODAL.HEADING: Help
HELP_MODAL.LEAD_MAILCLIENT: Souvera Mail talks to every common mail app — Thunderbird, Apple Mail, Outlook, K-9 Mail, FairEmail and others. Enter the server details below there.
HELP_MODAL.CALLOUT_TITLE: Important: you need an app password, not your login password
HELP_MODAL.CALLOUT_INTRO: External programs cannot sign in with your normal Souvera login password — they need their own app password per device.
HELP_MODAL.CALLOUT_STEP_1: Click your profile picture at the top-right → Settings
HELP_MODAL.CALLOUT_STEP_2: Select Security & devices in the left menu
HELP_MODAL.CALLOUT_STEP_3: Under “Create new app password” pick a name (e.g. “Thunderbird laptop”, “iPhone”)
HELP_MODAL.CALLOUT_STEP_5: Copy it right away and enter it in your mail client as the password — the username is your email address
HELP_MODAL.CALLOUT_HINT: One app password per device. If you lose a phone you can revoke only that password from the same menu — every other device stays connected.
HELP_MODAL.PASSWORD_DETAIL: Your personal app password (see the instructions above) — not your login password.
HELP_MODAL.TIP_STARTTLS: Tip: If your mail app asks for “STARTTLS” → port 143 (IMAP) or 587 (SMTP). For “SSL/TLS” use the default ports 993/465/995. Souvera Mail shows the exact values for your account above.
HELP_MODAL.LEAD_CALDAV: Sync calendars and address books with Apple Mail, Thunderbird, DAVx⁵ (Android) or any other CalDAV/CardDAV client. Sign in with your app password.
HELP_MODAL.CALDAV_TIP:
iOS / macOS: Settings → Calendar → Add account → Other → Add CalDAV account. The server address is the host part of the URL (e.g. —).
Android: DAVx⁵ (F-Droid / Play Store) — paste the full URL, use the app password.
Thunderbird: Calendar → New calendar → On the network → CalDAV. URL above, app password.
HELP_MODAL.SHIELD_INTRO: Review held messages, lift sender blocks or release mail. Opens in a new tab.
HELP_MODAL.APP_K9_DESC: Open source, supports IMAP + SMTP + STARTTLS/SSL. Set up with email and app password.
HELP_MODAL.APP_TBIRD_DESC: The classic. On Android as “Thunderbird for Android” (K-9 successor). Auto-config.
HELP_MODAL.APP_APPLEMAIL_DESC: Manually: Settings → Mail → Accounts → Other → Add mail account. Use the IMAP values above.
HELP_MODAL.APP_DAVX5_DESC: For calendar + contacts. Combined with K-9 + OpenTasks it gives you the full suite on Android.
HELP_MODAL.APP_FAIRMAIL_DESC: Alternative to K-9. Privacy focus, PGP support, all auth modes.
HELP_MODAL.APP_OUTLOOK_DESC: When adding: Advanced setup → Internet email. IMAP/SMTP values above.
HELP_MODAL.LEAD_SHORTCUTS: All shortcuts at a glance. Open this dialog any time with <kbd>F1</kbd>.
HELP_MODAL.EXT_LEAD: Attach an existing mailbox from another provider (web.de, GMX, t-online.de, Gmail, …) so you can read and send everything from Souvera Mail without switching apps.
HELP_MODAL.EXT_HOW_TITLE: How to attach an external mailbox
HELP_MODAL.EXT_HOW_STEP_1: Open Settings → Accounts (top-right avatar → the gear icon inside Souvera Mail).
HELP_MODAL.EXT_HOW_STEP_3: Enter the email address of the external mailbox and its password (see notes below for Gmail / Outlook).
HELP_MODAL.EXT_HOW_STEP_4: Souvera Mail auto-detects the correct IMAP/SMTP settings for major providers. Verify and click Add.
HELP_MODAL.EXT_HOW_STEP_5: The mailbox now appears in the top-left dropdown; switch between accounts without leaving the app.
HELP_MODAL.EXT_PRIVACY_BODY: Your external-provider password is stored encrypted at rest on this Souvera server (per-user key derived from the internal APP_SALT). It is used exclusively to fetch and send mail for that mailbox and is never transmitted to third parties.
HELP_MODAL.EXT_LIMITS_MAX: Your admin has set a maximum of 3 external mailboxes per user.
HELP_MODAL.EXT_LIMITS_GUARD: If Souvera Mail cannot send through the external SMTP server 3 times in a row within 24 hours, the account is automatically deactivated. Ask support (or run occ souvera_mail:external:revoke <uid> <email> --reset) to re-enable.
HELP_MODAL.EXT_GMAIL_NOTE: Gmail — requires 2FA on your Google account plus a per-app "App password". Set it up at myaccount.google.com/apppasswords.
HELP_MODAL.EXT_OUTLOOK_NOTE: Outlook / Hotmail — Microsoft disabled classic Basic-Auth in Sept 2024. Use a legacy App Password.
HELP_MODAL.EXT_WEBDE_NOTE: web.de / GMX — enable POP3/IMAP access in the provider's web interface first, then add here.
HELP_MODAL.EXT_TONLINE_NOTE: Telekom / t-online.de — you need the "Passwort für E-Mail-Programme", not your general Telekom login.

EXTERNAL_ACCOUNTS.CONSENT_TITLE: Before you add an external mailbox
EXTERNAL_ACCOUNTS.CONSENT_BODY: Your credentials for the external provider (e.g. web.de, GMX, Gmail) will be stored encrypted on this Souvera server and used exclusively to fetch and send your mail. They are never shared with third parties. Continue?
EXTERNAL_ACCOUNTS.WARN_GMAIL: Gmail requires an App Password (2-factor authentication must be on). Your normal Google password will NOT work.
EXTERNAL_ACCOUNTS.WARN_OUTLOOK: Outlook.com / Hotmail disabled classic Basic-Auth in September 2024. You need a legacy App Password from your Microsoft account.
EXTERNAL_ACCOUNTS.WARN_YAHOO: Yahoo requires a third-party App Password. Your normal Yahoo password will NOT work.
EXTERNAL_ACCOUNTS.CAP_REACHED: You have reached the maximum number of external mailboxes allowed by your administrator.
EXTERNAL_ACCOUNTS.FEATURE_DISABLED: External mailboxes are not enabled on this server.
EXTERNAL_ACCOUNTS.MANUAL_CONFIG_HINT: Only fill this in if your provider is not detected automatically or if you want to connect a custom domain (e.g. hosted on your own server).
EXTERNAL_ACCOUNTS.MANUAL_FALLBACK_HINT: The provider for this domain could not be detected automatically. Please enter the IMAP and SMTP server details manually below.
